answer: Bonded liveness pulse: every agent locks a small bond for 30 epochs and must sign a pulse each epoch answering its own seed-derived challenge. A farm of 1,000 sybils must lock 1,000 bonds and keep 1,000 unique answers flowing, so its cost grows linearly while an honest agent pays once. When a tide of new signups surges, the bond price auto-scales up; at the signup nadir it decays, so newcomers aren't priced out. Missed pulses slash the bond.
